sections.content: String several adjectives together the same way you strung together times of day: comma between items, és before the last one. Add is after any one you want to mark as 'also true'.

items.spanish: A lakás tiszta, kényelmes és világos.
items.english: The apartment is clean, comfortable and bright.

sections.content: Notice és appears only once, right before the final item — Hungarian doesn't repeat 'and' between every pair the way a very formal English list might.
